title: Client Side Formatting
description: Client Side Formatting is a simple mod that adds the ability to use client-side text formatting.
body:
Client Side Formatting is a simple mod that adds the ability to use client-side text formatting using the new **`$%`** prefix.

With it, you can conveniently create colorful and stylized text without affecting other players and without the need for commands or additional permissions. All changes are made locally, so you see the formatted text exactly as you want.

### Features

* Chat message formatting.
* Book editing support.
* Item name formatting in the anvil.
* Text support on signs.
* Completely client-side.
* Lightweight and easy to use.

### How to use?

Simply add the **`$%`** prefix before the formatting codes. The mod will automatically process them and display the appropriately formatted text.

Examples:
![Item rename](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/51b2f48ce335d32af9e3a4a1889d19b48fccc07a.png)
![Chat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f02e24f9c14e4fc46ee32a1934b9ccfec010ff77.png)
![Sign](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3120bf1b55b62d58576d0962dbcd3753f766a046.png)
![Book](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc4b04dbd9293d60c7a30ae7b6ca4c91f43ac161.png)
Client Side Formatting allows you to customize how text is displayed in-game while maintaining full server compatibility because it doesn't require server-side installation.
